triadic_specialization.CIF_E: All finite nonempty subset-composites of the three exact parent carrier identities distinguishable by protected ancestry vector and admitted on complete inherited K3 support.
triadic_specialization.QV_E: Witnessed association/dissociation routes on inherited complete support, using the exact parent constitutive quadratic form for binding and the exact parent edge rate as the only kinetic prefactor.
triadic_specialization.RFL_E: Positive composite abundance history, exact carrier ledgers, route/event history, freeze-out witness, covariance envelope and restart state.

state_space.selection_rule: At MINIMAL_SPINE admit each nonempty subset of the three protected carrier identities exactly once. Repeated identical-carrier occupancy is excluded because no independent parent witness distinguishes a second copy of the same internal carrier at this scope.

parent_constitutive_energy.symbolic_check: Wolfram: singleton and heterotypic-dimer energies are 2a, triad energy is 0; heterotypic pair binding=2a, dimer+complement binding=4a, same-type binding=-4a.
parent_constitutive_energy.interpretation: The exact parent Laplacian-complement energetically admits heterotypic subset closure and rejects same-type doubling. These are internal RFC composite identities, not measured nuclear binding energies.

reaction_hypergraph.reverse_rule: Every forward route has its exact ancestry-reversing route. Forward and reverse share one source-owned route pair and are not tuned independently.

invariants.symbolic_check: Wolfram returns exact zero for all four invariant rows multiplied by the 7x12 stoichiometric matrix; matrix rank=4 and left-nullity=3 for independent ancestry ledgers.
invariants.physical_name_boundary: These are ancestry-carrier ledgers. Physical baryon/electric-charge correspondence is unassigned.

rate_law.forward_prefactor_rule: kF=a for each inherited-support association route.
rate_law.detailed_balance_rule: kR=a*exp(-B_r/Theta_E), with B_r taken only from E_C binding release. This uses the already-derived D canonical spectral coordinate and introduces no independent reverse coefficient.

initial_state.rule: Lift exact D terminal carrier distribution into E species basis with newly opened composites initially unoccupied.

clock_and_interval.clock: tau_E, dimensionless continuation of intrinsic post-Big-Implosion order; tau_E=0 at D export.
clock_and_interval.accepted_t_end_rule: one slowest internally derived reverse-route timescale, 1/kr_triad; interval doubling is the frozen convergence check
clock_and_interval.wolfram_precheck: At t_end=1/kr_triad, an independent stiff integration reaches max |dY/dtau_E| below 4e-19; doubling and larger multiples remain stationary to numerical precision. This is pre-execution method verification, not the primary repository solver result.

uncertainty.rule: Recompute full E derivation for delta={4.66915,4.6692,4.66925} without retuning; no empirical rate uncertainty is asserted at MINIMAL_SPINE.

countermodels_and_ablations: SCALAR_COLLAPSE: replace X0,X1,X2 by one scalar before composite construction; must erase ancestry routes and fail the no-scalar-collapse gate.
EDGE_WITHHELD: remove one inherited K3 association lane; must materially change the terminal route-resolved state.
SAME_TYPE_ADMISSION: Xi+Xi is rejected because the same parent energy law gives binding release -4a.
INDEPENDENT_REVERSE_COEFFICIENT: forbidden; reverse coefficient is fixed by the frozen detailed-balance rule.
PUBLIC_NUCLEAR_INPUT: any isotope mass, cross section, lifetime, abundance target, Kelvin/MeV temperature or standard BBN rate is a hard fail.
NO_RFL_MEMORY: discarding route ancestry after integration violates protected no-loss memory.
falsifiers: empirical or Standard Model species label enters generation
same-type composite admitted despite negative derived binding release
any ancestry invariant residual exceeds 1e-12 symbolically or 1e-9 numerically
public or remembered abundance/rate/scale enters generation
independent reconstruction disagreement exceeds frozen tolerance
claim_boundary: E0 establishes an internally typed, source-owned, dimensionless primordial-composite reaction spine generated from the exact A-D RFC lineage. It may establish witnessed composite formation, reversible reaction flow, exact ancestry-carrier conservation, freeze-out, covariance, replay and independent reconstruction. It does not establish empirical proton/neutron/isotope identity, dimensional nuclear masses or bindings, standard BBN rates, Kelvin/MeV thermal history, measured primordial abundances or empirical agreement.
